title: CreativeDNA
description: Gene-level creative attribute vector (GROWTH-OS-BUILD-SPEC §15.5, §14.1). The unit of attribute-level creative learning (Moat #2): every asset is tagged with its DNA so the optimizer learns CPqL posteriors per gene (hook_type/angle/format/visual_treatment/color_family/copy_framework/language), and so QA can detect Entity-ID cluster risk (§15.4). Frozen-after-merge; new genes ⇒ version bump.

version.description: Schema version of this CreativeDNA shape. Bump on any field change (frozen-after-merge, §6.2 extend-never-mutate).

angle.description: The persuasion angle / message strategy this creative expresses. Ties back to the CIB angle id (campaign_intelligence_brief.angles[].id) when sourced from a brief.

angle_ref.description: Optional id of the CIB angle (campaign_intelligence_brief.angles[].id) this DNA was generated from, for attribute-level credit attribution.

hook_type.description: The opening device of the creative (first 0–3s for video, first-glance for static). A primary learning gene (§12.4 mitosis preserves angle+hook_type genes).

visual_treatment.description: The dominant visual style of the asset (drives Entity-ID cluster risk §15.4: same hero/backdrop clusters).

color_family.description: The dominant color palette family of the rendered asset (brand-kit aware).

copy_framework.description: The copywriting structure of the headline/body text.

language.description: Primary language/locale of the copy (BCP-47-ish). India vernacular is first-class (§I13: per-language CPqL posteriors).

secondary_language.description: Optional secondary language for code-mixed (e.g. Hinglish) creatives.
